entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Khuang Aphaiwong, also known by his noble title Luang Kowit-aphaiwong, was the founder of the Democrat Party and three times the prime minister of Thailand: from August 1944 to 1945, from January to May 1946, and from November 1947 to April 1948.
